reference_job_assignments.description: Explicit role mapping for attached zero-indexed reference assets (e.g. Image 1, Image 2, Video 1).

scene_format_mood.description: Environment, format, resolution, lighting mood, genre, and aesthetic tone.

one_dominant_action.description: Single primary physical action to prevent action collapse and visual morphing.

camera_path_and_framing.description: Natural cinematographic descriptions of camera path, lens depth, and movement. NO bracketed parameters.

lighting_and_palette.description: Light sources, exposure behavior, color grading, highlights, and color palette.

sound_clause.description: Timecoded audio instructions including spoken lip-synced dialogue, environmental SFX, and musical elements.

final_beat_and_composition.description: The camera resting point and exact final frame composition.

negative_directions.description: Explicit style exclusions, morphing bans, artifact preventions, and locked continuity elements.
